1.title: Inside the Oval Office Showdown Between Trump and Jeanine Pirro
1.summary: Jeanine Pirro, the U.S. attorney for the District of Columbia, told President Trump that his interior secretary, Doug Burgum, had misled him with a self-serving cover story for his own mistakes.

2.title: SpaceX's first-ever earnings show higher revenues and huge spending
2.summary: Elon Musk's company has struggled to maintain investor enthusiasm that greeted its stock market debut.

3.title: Missouri Says Voters Cannot Decide on Redrawn Congressional Districts
3.summary: Opponents of the new map, which was redrawn to benefit Republicans, had gathered signatures seeking a statewide vote. The issue could now move to the courts.

4.title: EU commends Spain's 'swift response' to Ceuta migrant crisis
4.summary: About 70,000 of the 72,000 people who came to Ceuta illegally last week have been returned to Morocco, Spain says.

5.title: Projectile sinks Indian-flagged ship off Yemen coast
5.summary: All 14 people on board the Indian-flagged vessel were safely rescued, India's ministry of external affairs says.

6.title: More than 170 migrants rescued after boat catches fire in Channel
6.summary: The government says all of the migrants, who were attempting to cross to the UK, will be returned to France.
